caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a weather vane. The composition centers on a vertical staff that is decorated with a carved, repeating leaf-like pattern in shades of light brown and tan. At the top of the staff is a horizontal rod, on which there are two animal figures: a larger gray and brown animal, likely a dog, stands at the left side, and a smaller animal of similar color stands to its right, near the center. To the far right of the rod is an arrow-like shape in yellow and orange, suggesting the pointer of the weather vane. On the left end of the rod, there are three small, vertically-stacked geometric shapes—hexagons or cubes—in red, brown, and blue. The background is an unadorned off-white or light beige color with no other markings or objects present.
title: Sheep Weather Vane
